detail.longDescription:
I’m on the pathway for setting up a Proxmox cluster with 3 thin clients, 2 of
which are deployed (but not the cluster until I get the third machine running).
I’m thinking of installing 4 VMs as follows: a) one for OpenWRT so that I can
get rid of my SKY router b) one for Opensense c) one for Frigate d) one for
Homeassistant/OpenHabian e) one for everything else (about 8 services with
docker) The thin clients are Optiplexes with 16-32 GB RAM. Do you think I am
overdoing this? Basically I want to keep my network VMs free from everything
else so that I don’t have to reboot these when I have to reboot the VM with all
the services.
